paragraphs: R' Yehuda ben Gadish (in the time of R' Eliezer), Eruvin 27a.[^1]

notes.text: Hyman lists R' Yehuda ben Gadish and places him in the time of R' Eliezer at the supplied Eruvin כז. locator, rendered 27a by the usual folio convention. No named passage at that locator was supplied in the distinct review or freshly collated for this change. Both abbreviated titles therefore remain R', and Hyman’s fully written אליעזר is retained as Eliezer. The chronology and patronymic remain Hyman’s statement; no father identity or teacher relationship is independently admitted. The older locator note remains archived with its English version; no new printed-pixel verification is claimed.
